text:
The best and most supportive doctors ever 🙏🏼🤍
My 1 year old puppy was bit by a large scorpion at 1am ON a SATURDAY NIGHT. I thought I was hopeless.
Not only did this animal hospital answer immediately, but the doctor went out of her way to console me personally over the phone about my situation.
I have called so many 24/7 veterinary hospitals. None were as comforting, truthful or knowledgable as this one.
No other animal hospital has ever  offered me any advice from the doctor personally, even for basic questions.
Not to mention, every other pet hospital, besides this one, had staff that were half asleep at reception (they just wanted extra money).
This veterinarian and animal hospital is the ONLY one we will trust from now on.
The doctor that talked to me calmed my anxiety like never before 🥹
After this experience, I always will bring my fur babies back here for their health, well being, and individual attention.
💯 service 🩵🐶

text:
Needed to see vet after hours, with my elderly dog. Vet on duty seemed competent and pleasant, from what I could tell. The dog lived (she probably would have anyway). That’s what the 3 stars are for - the bare basics.

Unfortunately, I have come to expect a little more from private veterinary care than what I found here. Based on this one encounter, my recommendation would be to look elsewhere for great vet care. There are quite a few excellent, well-run practices in our area.
